finish_summary:
1) bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity >=50 (expected 10%).
2) parse_coupon rejects valid coupons with leading/trailing whitespace and case‑insensitive prefixes; also rejects the maximum value 50.
3) Cart.items() returns a dict of name → quantity only, but spec requires name → (unit_price, quantity).
4) remove_item leaves an entry with quantity 0 after the last unit is removed; spec says the item should be removed entirely.
